newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest spot products steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest spot products steady in thin trade.

text.p: U.S. Northwest product prices were steady in thin trade on Monday, reacting to relatively quiet Californian markets.
Regular unleaded gasoline was assessed at 69.00 to 70.00 cents a gallon.
Premium was seen 7.50 cents a gallon higher.
In distillates, jet fuel was notionally stable from late last week at 79/80 cents a gallon.
Low sulphur diesel remained steady at 79/80 cents.
